description: Portable Microsoft C/C++ compiler and Windows SDK, installed with the DevTools native C# downloader.

script: Write-Host 'This package downloads Microsoft MSVC and Windows SDK under the Microsoft license terms:'
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Portable MSVC download/extraction failed. See the output above. Remove the failed Scoop install before retrying.' }

notes: Run msvc-shell to open a CMD session configured for MSVC x64.
Run portable-msvc info to see the actual compiler and SDK versions.
Run portable-msvc run -- cl /? to run a command with the compiler environment.
In DevTools Studio > Development > Portable MSVC, choose the toolchain folder inside this package.
Scoop's version is the downloader version. Microsoft compiler/SDK versions are selected from the current stable catalog at install time.
Uninstall removes the Scoop-managed toolchain. Other existing MSVC installations are not used or changed.
